displayName: PlanSwap: Claude Code & Codex Account Switcher
description: See what is left on your Claude Code and Codex subscription accounts (Pro, Max, Plus…), get told which one to use when one runs low, and switch from the sidebar. WSL/Linux and Windows.
command.openTerminal: Run claude in Terminal with Account
command.codex.openTerminal: Run codex in Terminal with Codex Account
command.codex.restartServer: Apply Codex Account: Restart or Show Instructions
command.claude.refreshAllUsage: Refresh Usage Limits of All Claude Accounts
command.codex.refreshAllUsage: Refresh Usage Limits of All Codex Accounts
command.tools.sync: Re-link Accounts to the Default Account
viewContainer.title: PlanSwap
view.name: PlanSwap
config.language.description: Language for the sidebar, status bar and messages. Command titles follow the editor language.
config.usageDisplay.description: Show remaining or used percentages in the sidebar and status bar. Colors always follow what is left.
config.usageAutoRefreshCurrentOnly.descr: Automatic checks query only the current Claude and effective Codex accounts. When off, other signed-in accounts are checked too. Manual refresh is unchanged.
config.usageCheckIntervalSeconds.descrip: Seconds between checks for accounts due for automatic refresh. Each account’s refresh age is set under Accounts.
config.notificationsEnabled.description: Notify when the current account’s 5-hour or 7-day quota reaches the notification threshold. Once per limit until reset; no notice for an exhausted limit.
config.notificationsThreshold.descriptio: Notify at or below this remaining percentage. Requires usage notifications to be enabled.
config.sidebarModelLimits.description: Show Claude’s model-specific limits below its general limits.
config.sidebarShortFormat.description: Use short sidebar limit labels and reset times such as 5d 12h. Full localized explanations remain in tooltips and accessibility text.
config.sidebarEmail.description: Show emails in the sidebar and status bar tooltip. When hidden, the tooltip uses account labels; names and aliases are unchanged.
config.sidebarFiveHour.description: Show each account’s 5-hour limit in the sidebar.
config.sidebarWeekly.description: Show each account’s 7-day limit in the sidebar.
config.claudeUsageAutoRefresh.descriptio: Claude: automatically check usage while this window is focused. Account scope follows planswap.usageAutoRefreshCurrentOnly. Manual refresh stays available.
config.claudeUsageRefreshMinutes.descrip: Claude: minutes before cached usage or the last check is due for automatic refresh. Requires automatic refresh; not an exact schedule.
config.claudeUsageTimeoutSeconds.descrip: Claude: seconds before a usage query times out. Applies to automatic and manual refreshes.
config.codexUsageAutoRefresh.description: Codex: automatically check usage while this window is focused. Account scope follows planswap.usageAutoRefreshCurrentOnly. API key accounts are skipped; manual refresh stays available.
config.codexUsageRefreshMinutes.descript: Codex: minutes before cached usage or the last check is due for automatic refresh. Requires automatic refresh; not an exact schedule.
config.codexUsageTimeoutSeconds.descript: Codex: seconds before a usage query times out. Applies to automatic and manual refreshes.
config.sidebarRecommendation.description: Show account recommendations and the lightbulb buttons used to exclude accounts.
config.statusBarEnabled.description: Show PlanSwap in the status bar.
config.statusBarProducts.description: Services shown in the status bar. Affects text, tooltip and color only; automatic checks continue.
config.statusBarAlignment.description: Place PlanSwap on the left or right of the status bar.
config.claudeConfirmSwitch.description: Claude: ask before switching accounts from the sidebar. Codex always asks.
config.sidebarRecommendationThreshold.de: Recommend when the current account’s lowest general remaining percentage is at or below this value. Requires recommendations; independent of colors.
config.usageWarningThreshold.description: Warning color when a limit has this percentage or less left. Applies to sidebar bars and the status bar background.
config.usageErrorThreshold.description: Error color when a limit has this percentage or less left. Applies to sidebar bars and the status bar background; error wins over warning.
